params.name: name
params.description: Select HealthcareServices with the specified name

params.name: service-category
params.description: Select HealthcareServices providing the specified category of services

params.name: service-type
params.description: Select HealthcareServices of the specified type (The type of service provided by this healthcare service)

params.name: specialty
params.description: Select services associated with the specified specialty (The specialty of the service provided by this healthcare service)

params.name: organization
params.description: Select HealthcareServices provided by the specified organization (The organization that provides this Healthcare Service)

params.name: location
params.description: Select HealthcareServices available at the specified location (The location of the Healthcare Service)

params.name: endpoint
params.description: Select HealthcareServices with the specified endpoint (Technical endpoints providing access to electronic services operated for the healthcare service)

params.name: coverage-area
params.description: Select services available in a region described by the specified location. (Location(s) service is intended for/available to)

params.name: _profile
params.description: Select resources based on a given HL7 profile.

params.name: _id
params.description: Select resource based on the logical `id`.

params.name: _lastUpdated
params.description:
Select resources based on the last time they were changed.

- Only date is supported in `yyyy-mm-dd` format.
- Prefixes supported are `eq`, `ne`, `gt`, `lt`, `ge` and `le`. Refer to their definitions at http://hl7.org/fhir/search.html#prefix.

eg: `_lastUpdated=eq2021-01-14`

params.name: id
params.description: Fetch a resource using its logical `id`.
